generate_random_er_graph: generate a random Erdos-Renyi adjacency matrix with optional directed, acyclic, or weighted graph settings
generate_sample_graph_and_distances: generate a jraph GraphsTuple and Floyd-Warshall distance matrix from a random graph sample
run_dataset_generation_cli: run the CLI to generate train, valid, and test graph dataset splits as compressed NPZ files
configure_maglap_precalc: configure MAG Laplacian precomputation settings with k, q, sign rotation, and symmetric norm options
set_average_degree_options: set average degree tuples for acyclic or regular graph generation splits
